description: The plot illustrates a comparison between Initial Accuracy and Final Accuracy across varying frequencies. The x-axis is labeled "o_pop frequency (x10^4)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 1 to 19, with tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The "Initial Accuracy" is represented by a solid green line with square markers and vertical error bars. It begins at an x-value of 1 with a y-value of approximately 0.34, rises to about 0.49 at x=5, and then declines to roughly 0.3 at x=7. It subsequently increases to reach a peak of approximately 0.52 at x=13, before declining to about 0.36 at x=17 and ending at approximately 0.41 at x=19. The "Final Accuracy" is represented by a dashed blue line with circular markers and vertical error bars. It starts at x=1 with a y-value of approximately 0.65, increases to about 0.86 at x=5, drops to roughly 0.72 at x=7, and then rises to a peak of approximately 0.91 at x=9. The line then declines to a local minimum of about 0.68 at x=13, rises again to roughly 0.9 at x=15, dips to about 0.82 at x=17, and concludes at approximately 0.9 at x=19.
